meta.site_description: naapurustot.fi — compare neighborhoods across every Finnish postal-code area on nearly 60 metrics. Income, property prices, services, safety, public transport and much more on an interactive map.
metric_explanation.air_quality_index: Modelled air-quality index: FMI SILAM nationally, HSY/FMI ENFUSER in the capital region. Lower is better.
metric_explanation.avg_construction_year: Weighted average construction year of dwellings.
metric_explanation.avg_household_size: Average number of people per household.
metric_explanation.broadband_coverage_pc: Share of buildings with access to ≥100 Mbit/s broadband.
metric_explanation.crime_index: Reported crimes per 1000 residents per year. Lower is better.
metric_explanation.crime_index_change_pc: Change in crime rate over the past five years. Lower is better.
metric_explanation.cycling_density: Cycling infrastructure (paths, lanes) per square kilometer.
metric_explanation.detached_house_share: Share of dwellings that are single-family detached houses.
metric_explanation.elderly_ratio_pct: Share of residents aged 65 and over.
metric_explanation.employment_rate: Share of working-age residents currently employed (ages 15–74).
metric_explanation.ev_charging_density: Electric vehicle charging points per square kilometer.
metric_explanation.families_with_childre: Share of households with at least one child.
metric_explanation.flood_risk: Share of the postal area's land inside SYKE's 1/100a flood hazard zone (a flood with a 1% annual probability). Higher = more flood-exposed land. Only within mapped areas; the rest are gray.
metric_explanation.foreign_language_est_: Estimated share of foreign-language speakers per postal code by year. 2020 is real postal-code data; 2021–2025 are an estimate: the real 2020 postal distribution multiplied by each municipality's relative change in foreign-language share (share_muni(y) / share_muni(2020), Statistics Finland vaerak 159t). Exact postal-code data is not published after 2020.
metric_explanation.foreign_language_muni: Share of foreign-language speakers by municipality (Statistics Finland, vaerak 159t, latest year 2025), assigned to postal codes — identical across a municipality's postal areas. A real municipal figure shown at postal-code resolution.
metric_explanation.foreign_language_pct: Share of residents whose primary language is not Finnish, Swedish or Sámi.
metric_explanation.gender_ratio: Women per man. 1.0 = balanced, above 1.0 = more women.
metric_explanation.he_vakiy: Total registered residents in the area.
metric_explanation.health_index: THL/Kela age-standardized morbidity index (national health index); 100 = national average, lower is better. Municipal value assigned to postal codes.
metric_explanation.healthcare_density: Healthcare facilities (hospitals, clinics, doctors' surgeries) per square kilometer. Pharmacies are not included.
metric_explanation.healthcare_workers_pc: Share of local jobs in healthcare and social services.
metric_explanation.higher_education_rate: Share of adults (18+) with a polytechnic or university degree.
metric_explanation.hr_ktu: Average yearly disposable income. Usually higher than the median because high earners pull the average up.
metric_explanation.hr_mtu: Median yearly disposable income across residents. Less affected by outliers than the average.
metric_explanation.job_self_sufficiency: Jobs located in the area per 100 employed residents (tp_tyopy / pt_tyoll). Above 100 = a net job importer / employment hub; below 100 = a residential area residents commute out of.
metric_explanation.light_pollution: Nighttime radiance (nW/cm²/sr) measured by NASA's VIIRS satellite (Black Marble). Higher means brighter night skies (more light pollution).
metric_explanation.low_income_pct: Share of households in the lowest national income decile (hr_pi_tul / hr_tuy). A high share signals a concentration of low-income households.
metric_explanation.manufacturing_jobs_pc: Share of local jobs in industrial manufacturing.
metric_explanation.new_construction_pct: Share of buildings currently under construction.
metric_explanation.noise_pollution: Average daytime traffic noise in decibels. Higher is louder.
metric_explanation.ownership_rate: Share of dwellings occupied by their owners.
metric_explanation.party_diversity_index: Normalised Shannon diversity of party vote shares in the 2023 parliamentary election. Higher = politically more even.
metric_explanation.party_vote_kesk_pct: Centre Party vote share in the 2023 parliamentary election.
metric_explanation.party_vote_kok_pct: National Coalition Party vote share in the 2023 parliamentary election.
metric_explanation.party_vote_ps_pct: Finns Party vote share in the 2023 parliamentary election.
metric_explanation.party_vote_rkp_pct: Swedish People's Party vote share in the 2023 parliamentary election.
metric_explanation.party_vote_sdp_pct: Social Democratic Party vote share in the 2023 parliamentary election.
metric_explanation.party_vote_vas_pct: Left Alliance vote share in the 2023 parliamentary election.
metric_explanation.party_vote_vihr_pct: Green League vote share in the 2023 parliamentary election.
metric_explanation.political_lean_index: Vote-weighted left–right position (0 = left … 100 = right) from 2023 parliamentary election party support. Party positions: Chapel Hill Expert Survey 2019.
metric_explanation.population_density: Residents per square kilometer of land area.
metric_explanation.price_to_rent_ratio: Years of rent needed to equal the property's purchase price. Higher means renting is relatively better value.
metric_explanation.property_crime_rate: Property offences (theft, break-ins, damage) per 1000 residents. A municipality-level figure. Lower is better.
metric_explanation.property_price_change: Property price change over the past five years.
metric_explanation.property_price_sqm: Average sale price per square meter from recent property transactions.
metric_explanation.public_sector_jobs_pc: Share of local jobs in public administration.
metric_explanation.ra_as_kpa: Average floor area of dwellings in the area.
metric_explanation.radon: Median indoor radon concentration in single-family homes (Bq/m³) by postal code. Lower is better; 300 Bq/m³ is the action level. Source: STUK.
metric_explanation.rental_price_sqm: Average monthly rent per square meter from recent rental data.
metric_explanation.rental_rate: Share of dwellings occupied as rentals.
metric_explanation.restaurant_density: Restaurants and cafes per square kilometer.
metric_explanation.school_density: Primary and secondary schools per square kilometer.
metric_explanation.school_quality_score: Mean grade of the local lukio's matriculation exam results across the last three spring sessions, shown on the YTL scale (I, A, B, C, M, E, L). Higher is better.
metric_explanation.service_sector_jobs_p: Share of local jobs in services (retail, hospitality, etc.).
metric_explanation.single_parent_hh_pct: Share of households that are single-parent families.
metric_explanation.single_person_hh_pct: Share of households with only one resident.
metric_explanation.sports_facility_densi: Sports facilities (gyms, fields, pools) per square kilometer.
metric_explanation.student_share: Share of working-age residents who are full-time students.
metric_explanation.tech_sector_pct: Share of local jobs in the information/IT sector.
metric_explanation.traffic_accident_rate: Road accidents per 1000 residents per year. Lower is better.
metric_explanation.transit_reachability_: Composite score of destinations reachable within 30 minutes by public transit.
metric_explanation.transit_stop_density: Public transit stops per square kilometer.
metric_explanation.tree_canopy_pct: Share of area covered by tree canopy (from aerial LiDAR data).
metric_explanation.unemployment_rate: Share of working-age residents registered as unemployed. Lower is better for labor-market health.
metric_explanation.violent_crime_rate: Crimes against life and health per 1000 residents, five-year average. A municipality-level figure. Lower is better.
metric_explanation.voter_turnout_pct: Share of eligible voters who voted in the 2023 parliamentary election.
metric_explanation.walkability_index: Composite of pedestrian friendliness: nearby services, footpath density and street connectivity.
metric_explanation.water_proximity_m: Population-weighted mean distance to the nearest body of water (sea, lake or river, min. 1 ha), measured from inhabited 1 km population-grid cells.
note.air_quality_index: Modelled air quality, not a station reading. A coarse grid model (FMI SILAM, ~5–10 km) distributed to postal codes; the capital region uses the finer ENFUSER model.
note.avg_construction_year: Municipality-level average construction year refined to postal codes using Paavo building data.
note.crime_index: Municipality-level crime statistics (Statistics Finland). No crime statistic is published below municipality level, so every postal code in a municipality shows the same figure.
note.cycling_density: Counts the number of OpenStreetMap cycleway segments per square kilometre, not their length. The figure partly reflects how finely paths have been split up on the map.
note.flood_risk: SYKE flood hazard maps (1/100a fluvial + coastal). Flood maps exist only for ~119 significant flood-risk sites; other areas are unmapped (no data). Source: Syke and the ELY Centres.
note.foreign_language_estimate: Estimate after 2020: the real 2020 postal distribution scaled by each municipality's change in foreign-language share. 2020 itself is real data.
note.foreign_language_municipal: Municipal figure (Statistics Finland vaerak 159t) assigned to postal codes; identical throughout the municipality.
note.health_index: Municipality-level THL/Kela morbidity index (Sotkanet, 2023) assigned to each municipality's postal codes. An estimate at postal-code level.
note.largest_municipalities: Covers only the largest municipalities; smaller areas have no data.
note.light_pollution: Based on NASA VIIRS Black Marble satellite nighttime radiance (250 m grid).
note.noise_pollution: Combines Helsinki's 2022 noise survey, the 2012 metropolitan-area traffic-noise survey, Väylävirasto road and rail noise, and Tampere. Unmapped areas use a modeled 40 dB background level.
note.osm_service_density: Based on OpenStreetMap features, not an official register. The figure is how many features are mapped in the area — national coverage runs at roughly 70–90 % of the official count, with more gaps in sparsely populated areas. A zero means nothing is mapped in OpenStreetMap, not necessarily that no service exists.
note.property_crime_rate: Municipality-level crime statistics (Statistics Finland). No crime statistic is published below municipality level. Withheld for municipalities under 2,000 residents.
note.radon: STUK single-family-home radon measurements (1980–2023) by postal code; areas with at least 10 measured dwellings. Covers roughly half of all areas; the rest show gray.
note.transit_reachability: Public-transport reachability for the Helsinki metropolitan area from the Helsinki Region Travel Time Matrix 2023 (University of Helsinki, Digital Geography Lab): a real 250 m travel-time grid; postal-code values are the mean of the grid cells in each area. Covers Helsinki metro only.
note.tree_canopy_pct: Copernicus HRL Tree Cover Density 2018 (10 m) nationally; HSY LiDAR land cover 2024 in the capital region.
note.violent_crime_rate: Municipality-level crime statistics (Statistics Finland), five-year average. No crime statistic is published below municipality level. Withheld for municipalities under 2,000 residents, where there are too few incidents for a reliable rate.
note.walkability: A composite index built from OpenStreetMap amenity, intersection and street-network data.
note.water_proximity: Distance is measured from inhabited 1 km population-grid cells (Statistics Finland) to the nearest water body of at least one hectare (OpenStreetMap), weighted by each cell's inhabitants. The figure therefore says how far the area's residents live from water on average — not where the postal area's boundary happens to reach.

privacy.s_account_b: If you create an account, we store a username, a hash derived from your password (never the password itself), and optionally an email address and display name. The account syncs your chosen favorites, shortlist, area notes and preferences (filter presets and quality-index weights) to the cloud. The email is optional; if provided it is stored but is not currently used for automated account recovery.
privacy.s_basis_b: Account data is processed on the basis of your consent: an account exists only because you chose to create it, and you can delete it at any time. The sole purpose of processing is to provide the account features — sign-in and syncing your choices across devices. We do not sell or share your data with advertisers.
privacy.s_contact_b: For privacy questions and requests, you can contact us by email:
privacy.s_noaccount_b: The map and all data are fully available without signing up or logging in. Without an account we store no personal data about you on our servers. Your settings, favorites and notes are kept only in your browser's local storage (localStorage) and never leave your device.
privacy.s_noaccount_h: The map works without an account
privacy.s_retention_b: Account data is retained for as long as the account exists. When you delete your account, all associated data is permanently removed. Data stored locally without an account stays only in your own browser, and you can clear it from your browser settings.
privacy.s_rights_b: You can download all data stored for your account as a JSON file and permanently delete your account directly in the service: sign in and open the user menu in the top-right corner. Deleting your account removes all of your data for good and cannot be undone.
privacy.s_thirdparties_b:
Cloudflare Turnstile: blocks automated sign-ups during account creation.
Sentry: collects technical error reports to help us keep the service stable.
Umami: self-hosted, cookieless visitor analytics that does not identify individual users.
Resend: delivers password-reset emails. Your email address and username are passed to it only when you request a password reset. Messages are sent from within the EU (Ireland).
Digitransit (HSL / Fintraffic): address search sends your typed query to Digitransit's geocoding service to locate the address, and the optional travel-time view sends the selected area's location to its routing service. These run only when those features are enabled.
Map background tiles are loaded from an external map-tile provider. We use no advertising trackers or third-party marketing cookies.

quality.explainer: This index reflects what actually makes a neighborhood good to live in — feeling safe, a healthy and calm environment, a secure livelihood, and easy daily life. Each dimension is scored once and then weighted.
quality.methodology_note: Wealth and amenity counts are deliberately kept modest, and the strongest driver of wellbeing — close relationships — can't be measured from open data. By default, scores are compared across all of Finland; switch the comparison scope to compare within the loaded region instead.

sources.methodology_body: The Quality Index is a 0–100 composite computed from about 50 factors grouped into four evaluative dimensions — safety & peace of mind, health/nature/calm, livelihood & purpose, and everyday freedom & ease — plus descriptive housing and demographic context. Each metric is normalized to its national range (winsorized 2nd–98th percentile) so areas are comparable across all of Finland.
sources.quality_note: Missing factors are dropped and the index is re-normalized over the available factors, so low-coverage areas are inherently less certain.
